options: The direct $30 billion increase becomes a $150 billion AD shift, raising excess desired spending to $330 billion at the reference price.

beforeRecord.q: A short recession causes tax receipts to fall and unemployment-benefit payments to rise automatically. Congress also approves an infrastructure stimulus, but construction begins after the economy has already recovered. Which comparison is strongest?
options: The infrastructure program cannot affect aggregate demand once the recession has ended.
The automatic stabilizers cushion the downturn and recede with conditions, while the delayed discretionary program can add demand after the original gap has faded.
Both responses have the same implementation timing because each changes the government budget.
The automatic stabilizers become contractionary during the recession, while delayed infrastructure is always stabilizing.
beforeRecord.commonError: Assumes automatic stabilizers and discretionary fiscal programs have the same activation and phase-out timing.
beforeRecord.feedback: Automatic stabilizers respond as income and employment change without new legislation; discretionary programs can arrive later and may outlast the original gap.

afterRecord.q: A short recession causes tax receipts to fall and unemployment-benefit payments to rise automatically. Congress also approves an infrastructure stimulus, but construction begins after the economy has already recovered. Which comparison is strongest?

Automatic stabilizers cushion the downturn; the delayed program may add demand after recovery.
Both responses have the same implementation timing because each changes the government budget.
The automatic stabilizers become contractionary during the recession, while delayed infrastructure is always stabilizing.
afterRecord.commonError: Assumes automatic stabilizers and discretionary fiscal programs have the same activation and phase-out timing.
afterRecord.feedback: Automatic stabilizers respond as income and employment change without new legislation; discretionary programs can arrive later and may outlast the original gap. Automatic stabilizers recede as the economy recovers.
